paragraphs.en: Modern video generators can realize increasingly complex visual narratives, positioning the prompt enhancer (PE) as a critical bridge from concise user instructions and multimodal references to structured cinematic plans. However, existing PE evaluation relies on rendered videos, imposing substantial computational and human costs, slowing PE training and iteration, and conflating PE quality with downstream generator behavior. To address this gap, we introduce PEBench, the first unified benchmark for direct PE evaluation across text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-to-video prompt enhancement. It comprises 1,100 expert-verified cases and 1,005 visual assets, spanning 35 fine-grained tasks with diverse temporal, cinematic, audiovisual, and multi-reference requirements. In addition, we develop PEBench evaluation, an evidence-grounded framework that combines modality-aware fact extraction with rubric-based assessment across 24 criteria. Our systematic evaluation of representative open- and closed-source PE methods reveals an emerging shift from fine-grained descriptive expansion toward intent-preserving cinematic planning, while the caption-reconstruction and forward-refinement methods show complementary strengths in cinematic coverage and semantic fidelity or internal coherence, respectively. Human validation shows that PEBench scores align closely with expert judgments of enhanced prompts and downstream videos from Wan3.0 and MiniMax-H3, indicating that prompt-level evaluation reliably reflects downstream utility.
paragraphs.zh: 现代视频生成器能够呈现日益复杂的视觉叙事，这使得提示增强器（PE）成为连接简洁用户指令与多模态参考信息、并生成结构化电影级计划的关键桥梁。 然而，现有的 PE 评估依赖渲染后的视频，这带来了巨大的计算和人力成本，延缓了 PE 的训练与迭代过程，同时将 PE 的质量与下游生成器的行为混为一谈。 为填补这一空白，我们提出了 PEBench——首个用于文本到视频、图像到视频以及参考信息到视频提示增强任务的统一直接评估基准。 该基准包含 1,100 个经专家验证的案例和 1,005 个视觉资产，涵盖 35 项细粒度任务，涉及多样的时间、电影叙事、视听及多参考需求。 此外，我们还开发了 PEBench 评估框架——一个基于证据的评估体系，它将模态感知的信息提取与基于评分标准的 24 项准则评估相结合。 我们对代表性开源和闭源 PE 方法的系统性评估显示，当前方法正从细粒度描述扩展转向保留意图的电影级规划；同时，标题重建与前向优化方法分别在电影叙事覆盖范围和语义保真度或内部一致性方面展现出互补优势。 人类验证结果表明，PEBench 的评分与专家对增强提示以及由 Wan3.0 和 MiniMax-H3 生成的下游视频的判断高度一致，说明提示层级的评估能够可靠地反映其下游应用价值。

paragraphs.en: Rapid advances in large-scale video generation models [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] have transformed content creation by enabling diverse video synthesis from natural-language instructions and multimodal references. Despite their remarkable capabilities, the quality and fidelity of generated videos remain strongly influenced by input conditions that adequately express user intent and generation requirements [ 4 , 5 ] . Concise or ambiguous user instructions can lead generators to misinterpret the bindings between subjects and actions, the intended event order, or the roles of visual references, revealing a mismatch between user intent and model interpretation. A prompt enhancer (PE) addresses this mismatch by converting user instructions and conditioning inputs into an enhanced prompt that guides downstream generation, making PE quality an important factor in high-quality video synthesis [ 5 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 大规模视频生成模型 [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] 的快速发展彻底改变了内容创作，使其能够根据自然语言指令和多模态参考生成多样化的视频。 尽管这些模型展现出卓越的能力，但所生成视频的质量与保真度仍高度依赖于能否充分表达用户意图和生成需求的输入条件 [ 4 , 5 ] 。 简洁或模糊的用户指令可能导致生成器错误理解主体与动作之间的关联、预期的事件顺序或视觉参考的作用，从而暴露出用户意图与模型解读之间的不匹配。 提示增强器（PE）通过将用户指令和条件输入转化为更完善的提示来缓解这种不匹配，该提示可引导下游的生成过程，因此 PE 的质量成为高质量视频合成的关键因素 [ 5 ] 。

paragraphs.en: However, PE development remains constrained by an indirect evaluation loop: validating each update requires downstream video synthesis followed by automatic scoring or blind human comparisons [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] . These computational and human costs delay feedback for training and refinement. Beyond this inefficiency, rendered videos reflect the joint influence of PE quality and generator capability, making observed errors difficult to attribute reliably to either component. These limitations motivate direct evaluation of enhanced prompts to assess PE quality independently of generator behavior and provide rapid, PE-specific feedback throughout iterative refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，PE 的开发仍受到间接评估循环的制约：每次更新都需要通过下游视频合成进行验证，随后还需进行自动评分或盲测式的人类对比 [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] 。 这些计算成本和人力成本会延迟训练与优化过程中的反馈。 除了这种低效性之外，渲染出的视频还反映了 PE 质量和生成器能力的共同影响，使得观察到的错误难以可靠地归因于其中任何一个组件。 这些局限性促使我们直接评估增强后的提示词，以便独立于生成器的行为来衡量 PE 质量，并在迭代优化过程中提供快速、针对 PE 的反馈。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we introduce PEBench , the first unified benchmark for direct evaluation of video prompt enhancers. As illustrated in Figure 1 (a), PEBench spans T2V-PE, I2V-PE, and R2V-PE, covering text-only, first-frame, and multi-reference conditioning. Figure 1 (b) summarizes 1,100 expert-verified cases and 1,005 visual assets, covering 35 fine-grained task types with broad variation in content, language, and conditioning complexity. To ensure diversity and quality, we employ a staged dataset construction pipeline combining broad scenario coverage with rigorous verification. Beyond dataset construction, the evidence-grounded framework in Figure 1 (c) evaluates each enhanced prompt against the original instruction and modality-aware facts extracted from visual inputs where applicable. Its 24 fine-grained criteria form three complementary dimensions: Semantic Fidelity verifies the preservation of source requirements, Internal Consistency examines narrative, spatiotemporal, and audiovisual coherence, and Directorial Creation assesses the quality of creative guidance for realizing the intended video. A unified rubric-based evaluator reports criterion pass rates and dimension scores, yielding an interpretable profile of PE quality.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们介绍了 PEBench——首个用于直接评估视频提示增强器的统一基准测试。 如图 1 (a) 所示，PEBench 涵盖了 T2V-PE、I2V-PE 和 R2V-PE，包括纯文本、首帧输入和多参考条件输入。 图 1 (b) 总结了 1,100 个经专家验证的案例和 1,005 个视觉资产，覆盖了 35 种细粒度任务类型，内容、语言和条件输入的复杂程度均具有广泛差异。 为确保多样性和质量，我们采用分阶段的数据集构建流程，将广泛的场景覆盖与严格的验证相结合。 除了数据集构建之外，图 1 (c) 中的基于证据的框架还会将每个增强后的提示与原始指令以及从视觉输入中提取的模态相关事实进行对比评估（如适用）。 其 24 项细粒度标准构成了三个互补的维度：语义保真度用于验证源要求是否被保留，内部一致性用于检验叙事、时空和视听连贯性，而导演创作则用于评估实现预期视频所需的创意指导质量。 一个统一的基于评分标准的评估器会报告各项标准的通过率及各维度的得分，从而生成一份可解释的 PE 质量画像。

paragraphs.en: Using PEBench, we systematically evaluate representative open- and closed-source PE systems across T2V-PE, I2V-PE, and R2V-PE, revealing four key findings, most notably an emerging shift toward cinematic planning among industry-developed PE and observed links between specific training strategies and capability profiles. (i) Prompt enhancement is evolving from fine-grained descriptive expansion toward intent-preserving cinematic planning as video generators become increasingly capable. (ii) Caption-reconstruction methods achieve broader cinematic coverage, whereas forward-refinement methods favor semantic preservation or internal coherence. (iii) Increasing temporal and reference complexity generally degrades PE performance. (iv) PEBench evaluation scores achieve Spearman correlations above 0.8 with expert rankings of enhanced prompts and downstream videos produced by Wan3.0 and MiniMax-H3, indicating that prompt-level evaluation reliably reflects downstream utility across generators.

paragraphs.en: Prompt Enhancement for Video Generation. As video generators increasingly support temporally structured and multimodally conditioned content [ 1 , 2 , 11 ] , prompt enhancers (PE) have become important for translating concise user intent into detailed instructions for downstream video generation. Existing approaches [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] broadly follow training-based or inference-time paradigms. Training-based methods learn prompt rewriting from constructed supervision or preference signals. VPO [ 6 ] and Prompt-A-Video [ 9 ] optimize LLM-based rewriters using supervised and preference objectives. WanPE [ 5 ] instead reconstructs detailed video captions from compressed prompts using video-grounded inverse pairs, while LingBot-Video-PE [ 15 ] maps expanded prompts into model-specific structured captions. In contrast, inference-time methods adopt diverse strategies: RAPO [ 8 ] retrieves relevant examples, while SCMaPR [ 7 ] performs agentic verification and correction. LTX-2.5-PE [ 16 ] directly rewrites prompts using its integrated Gemma 4 text encoder [ 17 ] , whereas H3-Context-IR [ 3 ] employs a multi-stage multimodal workflow.

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks for Video Generation and Prompt Enhancement. Video-generation benchmarks have evolved from assessing T2V quality and prompt alignment [ 18 , 19 , 20 ] to covering reference-conditioned, multi-shot, audio-video, and streaming generation [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 ] . However, these benchmarks are designed to assess rendered videos rather than enhanced prompts. Applying them to PE evaluation requires an additional generation stage, increasing evaluation cost and latency while entangling PE performance with downstream generator behavior. As summarized in Table 1 , PEBench instead evaluates enhanced prompts directly across T2V-PE, I2V-PE, and R2V-PE using standardized rubrics covering 24 criteria, enabling fine-grained assessment independent of downstream video generation while offering broad coverage of prompt structures and conditioning modalities at scale.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成与提示增强基准测试。 视频生成基准测试已从评估 T2V 质量和提示对齐 [ 18 , 19 , 20 ] 发展至涵盖参考条件约束、多帧输入、音视频同步以及流式生成 [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 ] 。 然而，这些基准测试旨在评估渲染后的视频，而非增强后的提示。 若将其用于 PE 评估，则需增加一个额外的生成阶段，从而提高评估成本与延迟，同时将 PE 性能与下游生成器的行为相互关联。 如表 1 所示，PEBench 则直接对 T2V-PE、I2V-PE 和 R2V-PE 中的增强提示进行评估，采用涵盖 24 项标准的标准化评分体系，实现独立于下游视频生成的精细评估，同时大规模覆盖多种提示结构与条件模态。

paragraphs.en: To provide comprehensive coverage, PEBench introduces a unified benchmark for evaluating prompt enhancers across three distinct task settings:
paragraphs.zh: 为实现全面覆盖，PEBench 引入了一套统一的基准测试，用于评估提示增强器在三种不同任务设置中的表现：

paragraphs.en: Text-to-Video Prompt Enhancement (T2V-PE). Given a user prompt and a target duration, with no reference assets ( ℛ = ∅ \mathcal{R}=\varnothing ), the PE should produce a detailed prompt that faithfully expands the requested video content.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到视频提示增强（T2V-PE）。 给定用户提示和目标时长，且没有参考素材（ℛ = ∅ \mathcal{R}=\varnothing），PE 应生成一个详细的提示，忠实地扩展所请求的视频内容。

sents.en: Text-to-Video Prompt Enhancement (T2V-PE).
sents.zh: 文本到视频提示增强（T2V-PE）。

sents.en: Given a user prompt and a target duration, with no reference assets ( ℛ = ∅ \mathcal{R}=\varnothing ), the PE should produce a detailed prompt that faithfully expands the requested video content.
sents.zh: 给定用户提示和目标时长，且没有参考素材（ℛ = ∅ \mathcal{R}=\varnothing），PE 应生成一个详细的提示，忠实地扩展所请求的视频内容。

paragraphs.en: Image-to-Video Prompt Enhancement (I2V-PE). Given a user prompt, a first-frame image ( ℛ = { I 0 } \mathcal{R}=\{I_{0}\} ), and a target duration, the PE should preserve the visible initial state and describe a coherent, instruction-aligned temporal continuation.
paragraphs.zh: 图像到视频提示增强（I2V-PE）。 给定用户提示、首帧图像（ ℛ = { I 0 } \mathcal{R}=\{I_{0}\} ）和目标时长，PE 应保留可见的初始状态，并描述一个连贯且与指令一致的时间延续。

paragraphs.en: Reference-to-Video Prompt Enhancement (R2V-PE). Given a user prompt, a set of reference images or videos ( ℛ = { a i } i = 1 N \mathcal{R}=\{a_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} ), and a target duration, the PE should incorporate each asset according to its specified role, such as subject, scene, style, motion, or cinematography, into a single coherent generation prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 视频参考提示增强（R2V-PE）。 给定用户提示、一组参考图像或视频（ ℛ = { a i } i = 1 N \mathcal{R}=\{a_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} ）以及目标时长，PE 应依据每个资产的指定角色（如主体、场景、风格、运动或摄影），将其整合为一个连贯的生成提示。

paragraphs.en: To construct a diverse and reliable benchmark, we develop a four-stage pipeline that combines automated synthesis and verification with expert-driven design and curation, as illustrated in Figure 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了构建一个多样化且可靠的基准，我们开发了一个包含四个阶段的流程，该流程将自动化合成与验证同专家主导的设计与整理相结合，具体如圖2所示。

paragraphs.en: Stage 1: Taxonomy design and composition. Domain experts define nine video genres and refine them into 35 fine-grained task types to establish broad and structured task coverage. They further specify five subject categories, eight scene domains, seven visual styles, and eight audio domains to guide scenario composition. Using the genre and these four additional dimensions, each scenario is represented as a ( genre , subject , scene , style , audio ) (\text{genre},\text{subject},\text{scene},\text{style},\text{audio}) quintuple.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 1：分类体系设计与组成。 领域专家定义了九种视频类型，并将其细分为 35 种精细的任务类型，以建立广泛且结构化的任务覆盖范围。 他们进一步明确了五个主题类别、八个场景领域、七种视觉风格和八个音频领域，以指导场景的构建。 利用视频类型以及这四种额外维度，每个场景被表示为一个 ( 类型 , 主题 , 场景 , 风格 , 音频 ) (\text{genre},\text{subject},\text{scene},\text{style},\text{audio}) 的五元组。

paragraphs.en: Stage 2: Prompt synthesis and diversification. We sample a scenario quintuple and associate it with a generation mode (T2V, I2V, or R2V), a fine-grained task type, and a target duration. Gemini 3.1 Pro [ 25 ] then synthesizes a user prompt from these specifications, jointly considering intent and modality, content composition, and duration planning. To reflect real-world prompting behavior, we vary instruction specificity from concise to detailed and temporal structure between single- and multi-shot formats, producing inputs ranging from short concepts to structured scripts.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 2：提示合成与多样化。 我们采样一个场景五元组，并将其与一种生成模式（T2V、I2V 或 R2V）、一个细粒度任务类型以及一个目标时长相关联。 随后，Gemini 3.1 Pro [ 25 ] 基于这些规范合成用户提示，同时考虑意图与模态、内容构成及时长规划。 为反映真实世界中的提示行为，我们将指令的具体性从简洁变为详细，并将时间结构在单示例与多示例格式之间变化，从而生成从简短概念到结构化脚本的输入。

paragraphs.en: Stage 3: Reference asset acquisition. We construct a diverse reference pool through two complementary routes. Public images and videos from existing datasets [ 26 , 27 , 21 , 28 ] undergo modality-specific curation for quality, safety, and reference suitability. Model-generated references produced with Wan-Image [ 29 ] , Seedream [ 30 ] , and GPT Image 2 [ 31 ] follow image-guided and text-guided pipelines to create identity-consistent variants and scenario-aligned assets. The resulting pool supports single-image, multi-image, video-only, and hybrid image-video conditioning.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 3：参考资产获取。 我们通过两条互补的途径构建一个多样化的参考池。 来自现有数据集 [ 26 , 27 , 21 , 28 ] 的公开图像和视频会经过针对特定模态的质量、安全性和参考适用性筛选。 使用 Wan-Image [ 29 ]、Seedream [ 30 ] 和 GPT Image 2 [ 31 ] 生成的模型参考资产，遵循图像引导和文本引导的流程，以创建身份一致的变化体和与场景匹配的资产。 由此形成的参考池支持单图像、多图像、仅视频以及图像与视频混合的条件输入。

paragraphs.en: Stage 4: Verification and curation. Each candidate undergoes a two-stage quality-control process combining scalable model-based screening with expert review. Gemini 3.1 Pro first derives case-specific checks from the instruction and target duration to detect infeasible or inconsistent specifications. For reference-conditioned cases, it jointly inspects the instruction and candidate assets to verify role correspondence, script-asset alignment, reference coverage, and cross-asset consistency. Ten domain experts then refine the verified cases for clarity and difficulty, removing ambiguous, template-like, infeasible, or redundant content while preserving dataset balance and diversity.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 4：验证与整理。 每个候选项都经过一个包含可扩展模型基础筛选和专家评审的双阶段质量控制流程。 Gemini 3.1 Pro 首先根据指令和目标时长推导出特定案例的检查项，以检测不可行或不一致的规格。 对于参考条件约束的案例，它会联合检查指令和候选资产，以验证角色对应性、脚本与资产的匹配性、参考覆盖性以及跨资产一致性。 随后，十位领域专家会对经过验证的案例进行优化，提升其清晰度和难度，同时移除模糊、模板化、不可行或冗余的内容，并保留数据集的平衡性和多样性。

paragraphs.en: Scale and Diversity. PEBench comprises 1,100 prompts across three PE tasks: T2V-PE (500), I2V-PE (300), and R2V-PE (300). As shown in Figure 3 (a,b), its taxonomy spans 9 video genres and 35 fine-grained task types, while its scenarios cover 5 subject categories ( e.g. , human and fantasy beings), 8 scene domains ( e.g. , domestic and nature), and 7 visual styles ( e.g. , photorealistic and 3D CGI), providing broad task, semantic, environmental, and aesthetic diversity.

paragraphs.en: Reference Asset Diversity. As shown in Figure 3 (e), PEBench contains 1,005 visual conditioning assets, with 944 images and 61 videos. I2V-PE uses 300 first-frame images, while R2V-PE includes 644 images and 61 videos in image-only, video-only, and hybrid configurations, with up to 7 images or 2 videos per case. paragraphs.en: Evaluating prompt enhancers through generated videos conflates prompt quality with downstream generator behavior while incurring substantial computational cost and feedback latency, slowing training and iteration. PEBench thus directly evaluates enhanced prompts along three dimensions: Semantic Fidelity ( SF ), Internal Consistency ( IC ), and Directorial Creation ( DC ). These dimensions respectively assess fidelity to the inputs, internal coherence, and creative directorial planning for realizing the intended video. Figure 1 (c) summarizes the 24 fine-grained criteria.
paragraphs.zh: 通过生成的视频来评估提示增强器，会将提示质量与下游生成器的行为混为一谈，同时还会产生巨大的计算成本和反馈延迟，从而减缓训练和迭代过程。 因此，PEBench 直接从三个维度评估增强后的提示：语义保真度（SF）、内部一致性（IC）以及导演创作性（DC）。 这些维度分别用于评估提示对输入的忠实程度、内部连贯性，以及为实现预期视频所进行的创造性导演规划。 图 1(c) 总结了这 24 项细粒度标准。

paragraphs.en: Semantic Fidelity. SF assesses whether the enhanced prompt preserves the original instruction and relevant information from visual references. Genre and Style Fidelity ( GSF ) measures retention of genre, medium, and visual style. Subject and Attribute Preservation ( SAP ) examines subject identity, appearance, and attribute bindings, while Action and Narrative Fidelity ( ANF ) covers actions, event order, and narrative intent. Dialogue and Lyrics Integrity ( DLI ) verifies verbal content, language, and speaker attribution, while Audio Requirement Preservation ( ARP ) covers speech, music, and sound effects. Camera Constraint Preservation ( CCP ), Lighting and Color Fidelity ( LCF ), Scene and Spatial Preservation ( SSP ), and On-Screen Text Integrity ( OTI ) respectively assess camera constraints, visual conditions, spatial relations, and visible text. In I2V-PE, the first frame anchors the initial state. In R2V-PE, each reference’s instruction-specified role determines the asset facts evaluated.
paragraphs.zh: 语义保真度。 SF 评估增强后的提示是否保留了原始指令以及视觉参考中的相关信息。 类型与风格保真度（GSF）衡量类型、媒介和视觉风格的保留程度。 主体与属性保留（SAP）考察主体的身份、外观和属性绑定，而动作与叙事保真度（ANF）则涵盖动作、事件顺序和叙事意图。 对话与歌词完整性（DLI）验证口头内容、语言和说话者归属，而音频要求保留（ARP）则涵盖语音、音乐和音效。 相机约束保留（CCP）、光照与色彩保真度（LCF）、场景与空间保留（SSP）以及屏幕文本完整性（OTI）分别评估相机约束、视觉条件、空间关系和可见文本。 在 I2V-PE 中，第一帧锚定了初始状态。 在 R2V-PE 中，每个参考的指令所指定的角色决定了需要评估的资产事实。

paragraphs.en: Internal Consistency. Whereas SF measures fidelity to the inputs, IC evaluates the logical and spatiotemporal coherence of the enhanced prompt. Subject and Attribute Continuity ( SAC ) assesses the stability of subject identity and attributes. Action and Narrative Logic ( ANL ) evaluates event progression, causal relations, and subject interactions, while Temporal and State Continuity ( TSC ) examines event order and state transitions. Spatial Consistency ( SPC ) assesses locations, relative positions, and movement paths. Physical Logic ( PL ) checks whether events follow real-world physics or established fictional logic. Audiovisual Synchronization ( AVS ) evaluates the alignment between visual events and associated dialogue, music, and sound effects.
paragraphs.zh: 内部一致性。 SF 衡量对输入的忠实度，而 IC 则评估增强提示的逻辑性和时空连贯性。 主体与属性连续性（SAC）评估主体身份和属性的稳定性。 行动与叙事逻辑（ANL）评估事件发展、因果关系和主体互动，而时间与状态连续性（TSC）则检查事件顺序和状态转换。 空间一致性（SPC）评估位置、相对位置和移动路径。 物理逻辑（PL）检查事件是否遵循现实世界的物理规律或既定的虚构逻辑。 视听同步（AVS）评估视觉事件与相关对话、音乐和音效之间的对齐程度。

paragraphs.en: Directorial Creation. DC assesses whether the enhanced prompt provides relevant, explicit, and creative direction to specify the intended video across temporal, cinematic, narrative, and audiovisual aspects. Storyboard and Timing Completeness ( STC ) evaluates shot organization and duration allocation. Camera Design Specificity ( CDS ) examines framing, viewpoint, focus, and camera movement, while Editing and Transition Design ( ETD ) evaluates shot connections and editing logic. Lighting and Color Specification ( LCS ) assesses illumination and color planning. Narrative Development and Engagement ( NDE ) measures content progression and variation, while Core-Intent Focus ( CIF ) checks whether added content supports the original request. Sound Design Integration ( SDI ), Subject and Performance Specificity ( SPS ), and Visual Style Specification ( VSS ) respectively evaluate audio design, subject presentation, and visual-style articulation.
paragraphs.zh: 导演创作。 DC 评估增强后的提示是否提供了相关、明确且富有创意的指导，以在时间、电影叙事、情节和视听方面明确预期视频。 故事板与时间完整性（STC）评估镜头组织与时长分配。 摄影设计具体性（CDS）考察构图、视角、焦点和运镜，而剪辑与转场设计（ETD）则评估镜头衔接与剪辑逻辑。 灯光与色彩规范（LCS）评估照明与色彩规划。 叙事发展与吸引力（NDE）衡量内容推进与变化，而核心意图聚焦（CIF）则检查新增内容是否支持原始需求。 声音设计整合（SDI）、主体与表演具体性（SPS）以及视觉风格规范（VSS）分别评估声音设计、主体呈现和视觉风格的表达。

paragraphs.en: Evidence-Grounded Fine-Grained Evaluation. We formulate evaluation as a two-stage process combining modality-aware evidence construction with unified criterion-level assessment. First, we construct this evidence using modality-specific extraction checklists. GPT-5.4 [ 32 ] extracts static visual facts from image-only inputs, while Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus [ 33 ] jointly analyzes all assets when video references are present, capturing static, temporal, audiovisual, and cross-asset evidence. Each fact is grounded in its source asset. The resulting ImageFacts for I2V-PE and AssetFacts for R2V-PE are constructed once and shared across methods. Second, GPT-5.4 serves as the unified evaluator across all three PE tasks. Given the original instruction, enhanced prompt, and applicable visual evidence, it assesses all 24 criteria using fixed criterion-specific rubrics and structured checklists. Shared evidence and fixed rubrics across methods enable consistent, interpretable criterion-level comparisons within each task setting. See Appendix B for more details.

paragraphs.en: Finding 1: Modern prompt enhancement is evolving from fine-grained descriptive expansion toward intent-preserving cinematic planning, enabled by increasingly capable video generators.
paragraphs.zh: 发现 1：现代提示增强技术正从精细的描述性扩展，向保留意图的电影级规划演进，而能力日益强大的视频生成器为此提供了可能。

paragraphs.en: Modern video generators can follow richer, more structured instructions for temporal progression, camera design, narrative development, and audiovisual coordination within a coherent generation plan, expanding the role of PE beyond local detail enrichment. This shift is evident in large-scale, industry-developed PE: WanPE establishes a clear lead in Directorial Creation on T2V-PE, while H3-Context-IR leads by substantial margins on I2V-PE and R2V-PE. Appendix B.3 contrasts descriptive expansion with structured cinematic planning across PE systems. Beyond this emerging industrial trend, Internal Consistency remains uniformly high, varying by less than 9 points within each task, whereas Semantic Fidelity and Directorial Creation each span more than 70 points on T2V-PE. These results indicate that the central challenge lies not merely in expanding prompts or maintaining internal coherence, but in cinematic planning that preserves user intent.
paragraphs.zh: 现代视频生成器能够遵循更丰富、更结构化的指令，在连贯的生成计划中处理时间推进、镜头设计、叙事发展和视听协调，从而将 PE 的作用从局部细节增强扩展到了更广泛的领域。 这一转变在由行业开发的大规模 PE 中尤为明显：WanPE 在 T2V-PE 的导演创作方面确立了明显优势，而 H3-Context-IR 则在 I2V-PE 和 R2V-PE 上以显著差距领先。 附录 B.3 对比了不同 PE 系统中描述性扩展与结构化电影规划之间的差异。 除了这一新兴的行业趋势，内部一致性仍然保持统一的高水平，在各项任务中的差异均小于 9 分；而语义保真度和导演创作在 T2V-PE 上的得分跨度则分别超过了 70 分。 这些结果表明，核心挑战并不仅仅在于扩展提示或维持内部连贯性，而在于如何制定能够保留用户意图的电影级规划。

paragraphs.en: Finding 2: PE trained to reconstruct real-video captions exhibits broader coverage of cinematic language, while forward-refinement methods excel at semantic preservation or internal coherence.
paragraphs.zh: 发现 2：经过训练以重建真实视频字幕的 PE 展现出更广泛的电影语言覆盖，而前向精炼方法则在语义保留或内部连贯性方面表现优异。

paragraphs.en: The dimension-level results on T2V-PE reveal a clear correspondence between enhancement paradigms and capability profiles. WanPE-397B and WanPE-35B are trained on pairs constructed by annotating real videos with a video captioner and reconstructing compatible user requests from the resulting captions, while retaining the full captions as targets. This supervision exposes them to real-world temporal organization, cinematic language, and audiovisual coordination, consistent with their leading Directorial Creation scores of 78.97 and 78.15 and their strong performance in storyboard and timing, editing and transitions, and sound design. In contrast, SCMaPR combines policy-conditioned rewriting, atom-level semantic verification, and conditional revision, whereas VPO trains a prompt optimizer through principle-based SFT and multi-feedback preference optimization. These mechanisms help preserve user requirements and constrain unsupported or contradictory elaboration, consistent with their respective leadership in Semantic Fidelity (87.92) and Internal Consistency (95.07), but their lower Directorial Creation scores (49.18 and 33.07) indicate narrower cinematic coverage. These complementary profiles suggest that effective PE should combine caption-derived planning knowledge with explicit semantic and logical constraints.
paragraphs.zh: T2V-PE 在维度层级的结果揭示了增强范式与能力特征之间的清晰对应关系。 WanPE-397B 和 WanPE-35B 的训练基于通过视频描述器对真实视频进行标注并构建的成对数据，同时从生成的描述中重构匹配的用户请求，并保留完整的描述作为目标。 这种监督机制使它们接触到了现实世界中的时间组织、电影语言以及视听协调，这与它们分别高达 78.97 和 78.15 的导演创作得分，以及在分镜与节奏、剪辑与转场、声音设计方面的出色表现一致。 相比之下，SCMaPR 结合了策略条件化的重写、原子级语义验证和条件修订，而 VPO 则通过基于原则的 SFT 和多反馈偏好优化来训练提示优化器。 这些机制有助于保留用户要求，并限制无法支持或相互矛盾的细节扩展，这与它们在语义保真度（87.92）和内部一致性（95.07）方面的领先表现一致；但较低的导演创作得分（49.18 和 33.07）表明其电影表现力的覆盖范围较窄。 这些互补的特征表明，有效的 PE 应当结合从视频描述中获得的规划知识，以及明确的语义和逻辑约束。

paragraphs.en: Building on the preceding findings, we analyze the necessity of prompt enhancement, the relationship between output length and adequacy, and the impact of task complexity.
paragraphs.zh: 基于前述研究结果，我们分析了提示增强必要性、输出长度与充分性之间的关系，以及任务复杂性的影响。

paragraphs.en: Original prompts reveal a substantial adequacy gap. We evaluate the original prompts as a no-enhancement baseline. Across all tasks, they achieve high Semantic Fidelity but low Directorial Creation. On T2V-PE, they attain 100.00 in Semantic Fidelity but only 33.56 in Directorial Creation, indicating that preserving user intent alone is insufficient to fully specify the intended video. This observation raises the question of whether greater prompt length necessarily yields higher Directorial Creation. A length-stratified analysis shows no consistent benefit: across tasks, the longest output quartile trails the shortest by 5.19-10.09 points (see Appendix C.2 for details). Effective PE should therefore add structured, task-relevant specifications for temporal planning, cinematography, narrative development, and audiovisual design rather than merely lengthening prompts.

paragraphs.en: Finding 3: Temporal and reference complexity remain persistent challenges for prompt enhancers.
paragraphs.zh: 发现 3：时间复杂度和参考复杂度仍然是提示增强器面临的持续挑战。

paragraphs.en: To examine these challenges, we use H3-Context-IR as a fixed enhancer and analyze two forms of task complexity: temporal complexity on T2V-PE and reference complexity on R2V-PE.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究这些挑战，我们将 H3-Context-IR 用作固定的增强器，并分析了两种任务复杂性的形式：T2V-PE 中的时间复杂性和 R2V-PE 中的参考复杂性。

paragraphs.en: Temporal-structure complexity. We analyze T2V-PE to isolate temporal complexity from visual-reference grounding. Specifically, we characterize temporal structure by the numbers of ordered event stages and explicitly requested shots, grouping both into 1, 2, and 3+. An event stage denotes a distinct action, state change, or outcome, while the shot analysis includes only prompts with explicit shot structures. Under these groupings, Table 4 shows that cases with three or more event stages trail those with one stage by 3.67, 3.92, and 1.98 points in SF, IC, and DC, respectively. The corresponding gaps for requested shots are larger at 9.97, 7.61, and 5.52 points. Together, these results show that both event progression and multi-shot organization pose temporal challenges, with the latter placing greater demands on cross-segment coordination.
paragraphs.zh: 时间结构复杂性。 我们分析了 T2V-PE，以将时间复杂性与视觉参考的接地问题分离开来。 具体而言，我们通过有序事件阶段的数量和明确要求的镜头数量来描述时间结构，并将两者分为 1、2 和 3+ 组。 一个事件阶段表示一个独立的动作、状态变化或结果，而镜头分析仅包括具有明确镜头结构的提示。 在这些分组中，表 4 显示，在 SF、IC 和 DC 指标上，包含三个或以上事件阶段的案例分别比仅有一个事件阶段的案例低 3.67、3.92 和 1.98 分。 对于要求的镜头数量，相应的差距更大，分别为 9.97、7.61 和 5.52 分。 综合来看，这些结果表明，事件推进和多镜头组织都带来了时间上的挑战，其中后者对跨段落的协调提出了更高的要求。

sents.en: Specifically, we characterize temporal structure by the numbers of ordered event stages and explicitly requested shots, grouping both into 1, 2, and 3+.
sents.zh: 具体而言，我们通过有序事件阶段的数量和明确要求的镜头数量来描述时间结构，并将两者分为 1、2 和 3+ 组。

sents.en: An event stage denotes a distinct action, state change, or outcome, while the shot analysis includes only prompts with explicit shot structures.
sents.zh: 一个事件阶段表示一个独立的动作、状态变化或结果，而镜头分析仅包括具有明确镜头结构的提示。

sents.en: Under these groupings, Table 4 shows that cases with three or more event stages trail those with one stage by 3.67, 3.92, and 1.98 points in SF, IC, and DC, respectively.

sents.en: The corresponding gaps for requested shots are larger at 9.97, 7.61, and 5.52 points.
sents.zh: 对于要求的镜头数量，相应的差距更大，分别为 9.97、7.61 和 5.52 分。

sents.en: Together, these results show that both event progression and multi-shot organization pose temporal challenges, with the latter placing greater demands on cross-segment coordination.
sents.zh: 综合来看，这些结果表明，事件推进和多镜头组织都带来了时间上的挑战，其中后者对跨段落的协调提出了更高的要求。

paragraphs.en: Reference complexity. On R2V-PE, we characterize reference complexity along two axes: quantity and modality. For quantity, we group image-only cases by 1, 2, and 3+ images. For modality, we compare image-only, video-only, and hybrid inputs. As shown in Table 4 , cases with three or more images trail single-image cases by 7.42, 4.39, and 2.71 points in SF, IC, and DC, respectively. The modality comparison reveals a larger gap. Hybrid inputs score only 45.62 in SF and 55.69 in DC, substantially below both single-modality settings, despite achieving the highest IC of 97.09. This divergence reveals a reference-grounding bottleneck. Enhanced prompts can remain internally coherent while failing to faithfully and adequately integrate heterogeneous references.

paragraphs.en: We present PEBench, the first unified benchmark for direct evaluation of prompt enhancers across T2V-PE, I2V-PE, and R2V-PE. It comprises 1,100 expert-verified cases and 1,005 visual assets spanning 35 fine-grained tasks encompassing diverse temporal, cinematic, audiovisual, and multi-reference requirements. Its evidence-grounded framework combines modality-aware evidence with 24 criterion-specific rubrics, enabling consistent, generator-independent assessment without costly video rendering. Our evaluation reveals an emerging shift from descriptive expansion toward intent-preserving cinematic planning. At the method level, caption-reconstruction and forward-refinement methods exhibit complementary strengths, suggesting that future PE systems should combine cinematic knowledge with semantic and logical safeguards. Meanwhile, performance degradation under temporal and multi-reference complexity highlights persistent challenges in temporal planning and cross-asset grounding. Strong alignment with expert judgments at both the prompt and downstream-video levels confirms the practical relevance of direct PE evaluation. By unifying task coverage, evidence-grounded assessment, and criterion-level analysis, PEBench provides a scalable foundation for evaluating, comparing, and advancing video prompt enhancers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 PEBench，这是首个用于直接评估 T2V-PE、I2V-PE 和 R2V-PE 中提示增强器的统一基准。 它包含 1,100 个经专家验证的案例和 1,005 个视觉资产，涵盖 35 项细粒度任务，涉及多样的时间、电影、视听和多参考需求。 其基于证据的框架将模态感知的证据与 24 项针对特定标准的评分规则相结合，从而实现一致且独立于生成器的评估，而无需耗费成本的视频渲染。 我们的评估显示，当前正出现从描述性扩展向保留意图的电影级规划转变的新趋势。 在方法层面，标题重建与前向优化方法展现出互补的优势，这表明未来的提示增强系统应将电影知识与语义和逻辑保障相结合。 同时，在时间复杂性和多参考场景下的性能下降，凸显了时间规划和跨资产定位方面持续存在的挑战。 在提示和下游视频两个层面与专家判断的高度一致，证实了直接评估提示增强器的实际意义。 通过统一任务覆盖范围、基于证据的评估以及标准层面的分析，PEBench 为评估、比较和推进视频提示增强器提供了一个可扩展的基础。

paragraphs.en: Prompt enhancement settings. The benchmark unifies three settings with progressively richer conditioning. T2V-PE contains 500 text-only cases. I2V-PE contains 300 cases, each paired with one first-frame image. R2V-PE contains 300 cases conditioned on one or more images or videos whose roles may include subject identity, object, scene, style, motion, cinematography, transition pattern, or audiovisual rhythm. paragraphs.en: Stage 1: Taxonomy Design and Composition

paragraphs.en: Domain experts define the nine capability categories and 35 tasks in Table 6 . The taxonomy covers visual, narrative, cinematic, speech, music, and sound capabilities. It therefore tests both frame content and the development of events, camera behavior, and audio over time. The experts also define the subject, scene, style, and audio vocabularies described in Section A.1 . Each candidate scenario is represented as a ( category , subject , scene , style , audio ) (\text{category},\text{subject},\text{scene},\text{style},\text{audio}) quintuple. It is then paired with a task, a prompt enhancement setting, and a target duration. Incompatible combinations are discarded rather than forced. Coverage is monitored across the dataset to maintain diversity without producing incoherent or infeasible requests.
paragraphs.zh: 领域专家定义了表 6 中的九类能力与 35 项任务。 该分类体系涵盖了视觉、叙事、电影化表现、语音、音乐和声音方面的能力。 因此，它同时测试了画面内容、事件发展过程、摄像机行为以及随时间变化的音频。 这些专家还定义了 A.1 节中描述的主题、场景、风格和音频词汇表。 每个候选场景表示为一个（类别，主题，场景，风格，音频）(\text{category},\text{subject},\text{scene},\text{style},\text{audio}) 五元组。 随后，该场景会与一项任务、一个提示增强设置以及一个目标时长进行配对。 不兼容的组合会被舍弃，而非强行使用。 系统会监控整个数据集的覆盖情况，以在保持多样性的同时避免生成无意义或不可行的请求。

paragraphs.en: Gemini 3.1 Pro synthesizes a candidate user request from the sampled specification. It considers the task and conditioning modality, the scenario composition, and the content that can reasonably unfold within the target duration. Instruction specificity ranges from short concepts to descriptive requests and detailed scripts. Temporal structure also varies. Some requests leave the shot structure implicit, while others specify ordered events, timestamps, or multiple shots. This process varies how much information and temporal planning are provided to the prompt enhancer.
paragraphs.zh: Gemini 3.1 Pro 从采样规范中合成一个候选用户请求。 它会考虑任务与条件模态、场景构成，以及能够在目标时长内合理展开的内容。 指令的具体性范围涵盖简短概念、描述性请求和详细脚本。 时间结构也存在差异。 一些请求未明确说明拍摄结构，而另一些则会指定有序事件、时间戳或多个拍摄镜头。 这一过程会影响提供给提示增强器的信息量与时间规划程度。

paragraphs.en: Cases with reference inputs use two acquisition routes. Public data selection draws candidate images and videos from existing datasets. Images are screened for visual quality, content safety, resolution, and redundancy. Videos are screened for visual quality and motion prominence, segmented into semantically complete clips, and represented by keyframes when a static reference is needed.
paragraphs.zh: 包含参考输入的案例使用两种获取途径。 公共数据选择从现有数据集中抽取候选图像和视频。 图像需根据视觉质量、内容安全性、分辨率和冗余度进行筛选。 视频需根据视觉质量和动作显著性进行筛选，分割为语义完整的片段，并在需要静态参考时由关键帧表示。

paragraphs.en: Generation with models expands the public pool using Wan-Image [ 29 ] , Seedream [ 30 ] , and GPT Image 2 [ 31 ] . In the image guided route, a primary image is used to create variations in viewpoint, pose, or expression while preserving identity. In the text guided route, Gemini 3.1 Pro converts the sampled scenario or a relevant shot description into a concise image generation instruction. Together, the two routes support single image, multiple image, video only, and mixed image and video conditioning. Each retained reference is assigned an explicit role such as subject, scene, style, motion, or cinematography.
paragraphs.zh: 使用模型进行生成，通过 Wan-Image [ 29 ]、Seedream [ 30 ] 和 GPT Image 2 [ 31 ] 扩展了公共资源池。 在图像引导路径中，使用一张主图来创建视角、姿势或表情的变化，同时保留身份特征。 在文本引导路径中，Gemini 3.1 Pro 将采样场景或相关镜头描述转换为简洁的图像生成指令。 这两条路径共同支持单张图像、多张图像、仅视频以及图像与视频混合的条件输入。 每个保留的参考项都会被分配一个明确的角色，例如主体、场景、风格、运动或电影摄影。

paragraphs.en: Stage 4: Automated Verification and Expert Curation
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 4：自动化验证与专家策展

paragraphs.en: Quality control combines automated screening with expert review. Gemini 3.1 Pro derives a checklist from each request and its target duration. It checks task alignment, logical coherence, and duration feasibility. For cases with reference inputs, it jointly inspects the instruction and candidate assets to verify their assigned roles, alignment with the script, reference coverage, and consistency across assets.
paragraphs.zh: 质量控制将自动化筛选与专家审核相结合。 Gemini 3.1 Pro 会根据每个请求及其目标时长生成一份检查清单。 它会检查任务一致性、逻辑连贯性以及时长的可行性。 对于包含参考输入的情况，它会联合检查指令和候选资产，以验证其分配的角色、与脚本的一致性、参考内容的覆盖范围以及各资产之间的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Ten domain experts review the verified pool. They refine awkward language, remove ambiguous or infeasible instructions, reject uninformative or mismatched references, and eliminate repetitive or redundant cases. They also monitor task balance, difficulty, and novelty across cases. The final benchmark contains 1,100 cases verified by experts and 1,005 visual assets.
paragraphs.zh: 十位领域专家对经过验证的池子进行审查。 他们优化生硬的语言，删除含糊不清或不可行的指令，拒绝无信息价值或不匹配的资料参考，并消除重复或冗余的案例。 他们还监控各案例中任务的平衡性、难度和新颖性。 最终基准包含由专家验证的 1,100 个案例和 1,005 个视觉资产。

paragraphs.en: Reference diversity and complexity. R2V-PE reference configurations comprise 3 types: image only (80.0%), video only (9.3%), and mixed image and video (10.7%). paragraphs.en: PEBench evaluates enhanced prompts using 24 criteria grouped into Semantic Fidelity ( SF ), Internal Consistency ( IC ), and Directorial Creation ( DC ). For each applicable criterion, the evaluator determines whether the enhanced prompt contains no issue, a minor issue, or a major issue, and cites evidence for that decision. A criterion is counted as passed only when no issue is identified. Criterion-level pass rate is therefore the percentage of applicable cases that pass the criterion, while each dimension-level score aggregates the number and severity of its constituent issues. Criteria tied to optional source content, such as dialogue or on-screen text, are applied only when that content is present or explicitly requested.
paragraphs.zh: PEBench 使用 24 项标准来评估增强提示，这些标准分为语义保真度（SF）、内部一致性（IC）和导演性创作（DC）。 对于每一项适用的标准，评估者会判断该增强提示是否存在问题、存在轻微问题或存在严重问题，并引用证据支持这一判断。 仅当未识别出任何问题时，某项标准才会被视为通过。 因此，标准层面的通过率是指符合该标准的适用案例所占的百分比，而每个维度层面的分数则会汇总其包含问题的数量与严重程度。 与可选源内容（如对话或屏幕文本）相关的标准，仅在该内容存在或被明确请求时才会应用。

paragraphs.en: Semantic Fidelity evaluates whether the enhanced prompt preserves the user instruction and instruction-relevant visual evidence. Added details must not omit, weaken, substitute, or contradict source requirements.

paragraphs.en: (1) Genre and Style Fidelity (GSF). Measures preservation of the requested genre, medium, aesthetic, and visual style. Replacing the medium, weakening a defining genre convention, or adding an incompatible reference style constitutes an issue.
paragraphs.zh: 类型与风格保真度（GSF）。 衡量所请求的类型、媒介、美学和视觉风格的保留程度。 更换媒介、削弱定义性类型惯例或添加不兼容的参考风格均构成问题。

paragraphs.en: (3) Action and Narrative Fidelity (ANF). Measures preservation of required actions, interactions, event order, outcomes, and narrative intent. Omissions, substitutions, reversals, or added events that alter the requested event chain are treated as issues.
paragraphs.zh: (3) 行动与叙事保真度（ANF）。 衡量所需行动、互动、事件顺序、结果和叙事意图的保留程度。 任何遗漏、替换、倒置或添加的事件，若改变了所请求的事件链，均被视为问题。

paragraphs.en: (4) Dialogue and Lyrics Integrity (DLI). Measures fidelity to dialogue, narration, lyrics, language, delivery, and speaker attribution. Exact quotations must not be paraphrased, deleted, translated, or converted into another form unless explicitly permitted.
paragraphs.zh: (4) 对话与歌词完整性（DLI）。 衡量对话、叙述、歌词、语言、表达方式及说话者归属的忠实度。 除非明确允许，否则不得对精确引文进行改写、删除、翻译或转换为其他形式。

paragraphs.en: (5) Audio Requirement Preservation (ARP). Measures preservation of speech, vocalization, music, sound effects, ambience, and silence constraints. Missing, substituted, or added sounds that violate negative requirements such as “no music” are penalized.
paragraphs.zh: (5) 音频要求保留（ARP）。 该措施确保语音、发声、音乐、音效、环境音以及静默部分的约束条件得到保留。 缺失、替换或添加违反“禁止音乐”等负面要求的音频内容将被扣分。

paragraphs.en: (6) Camera Constraint Preservation (CCP). Measures preservation of shot count, scale, angle, lens, focus, movement, and single-take or static-camera constraints. Added camera design is allowed only where it does not override explicit cinematic intent.
paragraphs.zh: (6) 摄像机约束保留（CCP）。 衡量镜头数量、比例、角度、镜头、焦点、移动以及单镜头或固定摄像机约束的保留情况。 新增的摄像机设计仅在被其不覆盖明确电影意图时允许使用。

paragraphs.en: (7) Lighting and Color Fidelity (LCF). Measures preservation of time of day, illumination, light quality, brightness, palette, saturation, contrast, and grading. Compatible elaboration is allowed, but it must not change a defining lighting or color condition.
paragraphs.zh: (7) 光照与色彩保真度（LCF）。 衡量对一天中的时间、光照、光线质量、亮度、色板、饱和度、对比度和色调分级的保留程度。 允许兼容的扩展，但不得改变定义性的光照或色彩条件。

paragraphs.en: (8) Scene and Spatial Preservation (SSP). Measures preservation of setting, background elements, layout, relative positions, and movement directions. Changing the location, removing required objects, or reversing spatial relations is a violation.
paragraphs.zh: (8) 场景与空间保留（SSP）。 衡量场景、背景元素、布局、相对位置及移动方向的保留程度。 改变位置、移除必要物体或颠倒空间关系均属于违规行为。

paragraphs.en: (9) On-Screen Text Integrity (OTI). Measures fidelity to visible titles, signs, subtitles, and interface text, including exact wording, spelling, language, placement, and timing. Visible text cannot be replaced by semantically similar spoken content.
paragraphs.zh: (9) 屏幕文本完整性（OTI）。 衡量对可见标题、标识、字幕和界面文本的忠实度，包括确切措辞、拼写、语言、位置和时间。 可见文本不能由语义相似的口语内容替代。

paragraphs.en: Internal Consistency evaluates whether the complete enhanced prompt is logically, spatially, temporally, physically, and audiovisually coherent.
paragraphs.zh: 内部一致性评估的是完整的增强提示在逻辑、空间、时间、物理以及视听方面是否连贯一致。

paragraphs.en: (10) Subject and Attribute Continuity (SAC). Measures stability of subject identity, count, appearance, clothing, props, and persistent attributes across shots. Unexplained renaming, duplication, disappearance, or attribute drift constitutes an issue.
paragraphs.zh: (10) 主体与属性连续性（SAC）。 衡量主体身份、数量、外观、服装、道具以及跨镜头持续属性之间的稳定性。 未经解释的重新命名、重复出现、消失或属性漂移均构成问题。

sents.en: (10) Subject and Attribute Continuity (SAC).
sents.zh: (10) 主体与属性连续性（SAC）。

sents.en: Measures stability of subject identity, count, appearance, clothing, props, and persistent attributes across shots.
sents.zh: 衡量主体身份、数量、外观、服装、道具以及跨镜头持续属性之间的稳定性。

sents.en: Unexplained renaming, duplication, disappearance, or attribute drift constitutes an issue.
sents.zh: 未经解释的重新命名、重复出现、消失或属性漂移均构成问题。

paragraphs.en: (11) Action and Narrative Logic (ANL). Measures whether actions form a coherent causal or procedural progression. The evaluator checks prerequisites, bindings between subjects and actions, reactions, resolution, and incompatible or dangling events.
paragraphs.zh: (11) 行动与叙事逻辑（ANL）。 衡量行动是否构成连贯的因果或程序性进展。 评估器会检查前提条件、主体与行动之间的绑定关系、反应、结果，以及不兼容或未解决的事件。

sents.en: (11) Action and Narrative Logic (ANL).
sents.zh: (11) 行动与叙事逻辑（ANL）。

sents.en: Measures whether actions form a coherent causal or procedural progression.
sents.zh: 衡量行动是否构成连贯的因果或程序性进展。

sents.en: The evaluator checks prerequisites, bindings between subjects and actions, reactions, resolution, and incompatible or dangling events.

paragraphs.en: (12) Temporal and State Continuity (TSC). Measures chronology, duration allocation, event order, and state transitions. Overlapping or infeasible timestamps, unexplained resets, and later shots showing states that should no longer exist are penalized.
paragraphs.zh: (12) 时间与时态连续性（TSC）。 衡量时间顺序、时长分配、事件顺序和状态转换。 重叠或不可行的时间戳、未解释的重置，以及后续镜头中出现本应不再存在的状态，均会受到扣分。

sents.en: (12) Temporal and State Continuity (TSC).
sents.zh: (12) 时间与时态连续性（TSC）。

sents.en: Measures chronology, duration allocation, event order, and state transitions.
sents.zh: 衡量时间顺序、时长分配、事件顺序和状态转换。

sents.en: Overlapping or infeasible timestamps, unexplained resets, and later shots showing states that should no longer exist are penalized.
sents.zh: 重叠或不可行的时间戳、未解释的重置，以及后续镜头中出现本应不再存在的状态，均会受到扣分。

paragraphs.en: (13) Spatial Consistency (SPC). Measures consistency of location, screen direction, relative position, orientation, trajectory, and entrances or exits. Unexplained position swaps or movement paths that cannot connect adjacent states constitute issues.
paragraphs.zh: (13) 空间一致性（SPC）。 衡量位置、屏幕方向、相对位置、朝向、轨迹以及入口或出口的一致性。 无法解释的位置交换或无法连接相邻状态的移动路径即构成问题。

sents.en: (13) Spatial Consistency (SPC).
sents.zh: (13) 空间一致性（SPC）。

sents.en: Measures consistency of location, screen direction, relative position, orientation, trajectory, and entrances or exits.
sents.zh: 衡量位置、屏幕方向、相对位置、朝向、轨迹以及入口或出口的一致性。

sents.en: Unexplained position swaps or movement paths that cannot connect adjacent states constitute issues.
sents.zh: 无法解释的位置交换或无法连接相邻状态的移动路径即构成问题。

paragraphs.en: (14) Physical Logic (PL). Measures compliance with real-world physics or established fictional rules, including gravity, contact, object permanence, bodily feasibility, and causal relations. Deliberate fantasy is judged by its own world logic.
paragraphs.zh: (14) 物理逻辑（PL）。 衡量对现实世界物理规律或既定虚构规则的遵守程度，包括重力、接触、物体恒常性、身体可行性以及因果关系。 有意识的幻想应依据其自身世界的逻辑进行评判。

sents.en: (14) Physical Logic (PL).
sents.zh: (14) 物理逻辑（PL）。

sents.en: Deliberate fantasy is judged by its own world logic.
sents.zh: 有意识的幻想应依据其自身世界的逻辑进行评判。

paragraphs.en: (15) Audiovisual Synchronization (AVS). Measures temporal and semantic alignment between visible events and dialogue, lyrics, music, effects, or ambience. Wrong speakers, premature effects, and misaligned lip-sync or beat-sync actions are penalized.
paragraphs.zh: (15) 视听同步（AVS）。 衡量可见事件与对话、歌词、音乐、特效或环境音之间的时序和语义对齐程度。 错误的发声者、过早生效的特效，以及不同步的口型或节拍同步动作均会被扣分。

sents.en: (15) Audiovisual Synchronization (AVS).
sents.zh: (15) 视听同步（AVS）。

sents.en: Measures temporal and semantic alignment between visible events and dialogue, lyrics, music, effects, or ambience.
sents.zh: 衡量可见事件与对话、歌词、音乐、特效或环境音之间的时序和语义对齐程度。

sents.en: Wrong speakers, premature effects, and misaligned lip-sync or beat-sync actions are penalized.
sents.zh: 错误的发声者、过早生效的特效，以及不同步的口型或节拍同步动作均会被扣分。

paragraphs.en: Even casually captured videos involve temporal progression, framing, camera behavior, lighting, performance, visual style, and sound. A prompt may preserve the source and remain logically coherent while leaving these directorial elements underspecified. To assess whether a prompt enhancer develops them into an actionable production plan, we introduce Directorial Creation, covering storyboarding, cinematography, editing, lighting, narrative, sound, performance, and visual style.
paragraphs.zh: 即使是随意拍摄的视频，也涉及时间推进、构图、摄像头行为、灯光、表演、视觉风格和声音。 提示词可能保留原始内容并保持逻辑连贯，但未能明确说明这些导演层面的要素。 为了评估提示词增强器能否将其转化为可行的制作计划，我们引入了“导演创作”环节，涵盖分镜设计、摄影指导、剪辑、灯光、叙事、声音、表演和视觉风格。

paragraphs.en: (16) Storyboard and Timing Completeness (STC). Measures whether the content is organized into a feasible temporal plan with adequate event or shot boundaries, ordering, and durations.
paragraphs.zh: (16) 故事板与时间安排的完整性（STC）。 衡量内容是否被组织成一个可行的时间计划，并具备适当的事件或镜头边界、顺序和持续时间。

sents.en: (16) Storyboard and Timing Completeness (STC).
sents.zh: (16) 故事板与时间安排的完整性（STC）。

paragraphs.en: (17) Camera Design Specificity (CDS). Measures actionable specs of framing, scale, angle, viewpoint, lens, focus, and movement.
paragraphs.zh: (17) 相机设计特异性（CDS）。 衡量构图、比例、角度、视角、镜头、对焦和运动等可操作规格。

paragraphs.en: (18) Editing and Transition Design (ETD). Measures whether cuts and transitions support temporal, spatial, narrative, or rhythmic progression. Disconnected shots or repeated transitions without clear continuity or motivation are considered inadequate.
paragraphs.zh: (18) 剪辑与转场设计（ETD）。 衡量剪辑和转场是否支持时间、空间、叙事或节奏上的推进。 缺乏明确连贯性或动机的断裂镜头或重复转场被视为不合格。

sents.en: (18) Editing and Transition Design (ETD).

paragraphs.en: (19) Lighting and Color Specification (LCS). Measures actionable specification of light source, direction, quality, contrast, palette, saturation, and grading.
paragraphs.zh: (19) 照明与色彩规范（LCS）。 对光源、方向、质量、对比度、色板、饱和度和色调的可行规范进行测量。

paragraphs.en: (20) Narrative Development and Engagement (NDE). Measures sufficient progression, variation, escalation, or resolution for the requested content form. Static restatement and unmotivated repetition are inadequate.
paragraphs.zh: (20) 叙事发展与参与度（NDE）。 需衡量所请求内容形式中足够的进展、变化、升级或解决。 静态的重复陈述和缺乏动机的反复是不充分的。

paragraphs.en: (21) Core-Intent Focus (CIF). Measures whether additions support the central request. Repetitive padding, template language, unnecessary subplots, and decorative details that distract from the intended result reduce adequacy.
paragraphs.zh: (21) 核心意图聚焦（CIF）。 衡量新增内容是否支持核心请求。 重复的填充内容、模板化语言、不必要的支线情节以及分散对预期结果注意力的装饰性细节，都会降低充分性。

paragraphs.en: (22) Sound Design Integration (SDI). Measures whether speech, music, effects, and ambience are integrated through source, character, intensity, progression, and visual timing. It rewards content-appropriate design rather than requiring every audio type.
paragraphs.zh: (22) 声音设计整合（SDI）。 衡量语音、音乐、音效和环境声是否通过来源、角色、强度、发展过程以及视觉时机实现了整合。 该指标奖励与内容相符的设计，而非要求每种音频类型都必须出现。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the ten prompt-enhancement systems listed in Table 2 , together with the original prompt as a no-enhancement baseline. paragraphs.en: For each case, modality-aware evidence is extracted once and cached for all methods. GPT-5.4 [ 32 ] extracts facts for image-only inputs, and Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus processes all assets for cases containing video references. GPT-5.4 then evaluates every enhanced prompt using the same criterion-specific rubrics. We report criterion pass rates and aggregate Semantic Fidelity, Internal Consistency, and Directorial Creation scores. The additional experiments analyze temporal complexity, reference complexity, and output length. Human studies further test prompt-level alignment and downstream utility using videos generated by Wan3.0 and MiniMax-H3. For downstream video generation, we access Wan3.0 through its online API with prompt enhancement disabled, while MiniMax-H3 is run locally on eight NVIDIA A100 GPUs.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个案例，模态感知证据会被提取一次，并为所有方法缓存。 GPT-5.4 [ 32 ] 会针对仅含图像的输入提取事实，而 Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus 则会处理包含视频引用的案例中的所有资产。 随后，GPT-5.4 会使用相同的特定标准评分表来评估每个增强后的提示。 我们报告了各项标准的通过率，并汇总了语义保真度、内部一致性和导演创作力的得分。 附加实验分析了时间复杂度、引用复杂度和输出长度。 人类研究进一步测试了提示层面对齐和下游效用，使用的是由 Wan3.0 和 MiniMax-H3 生成的视频。 对于下游视频生成，我们通过其在线 API 访问 Wan3.0，并禁用提示增强功能；而 MiniMax-H3 则在八块 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上本地运行。

paragraphs.en: Prompt enhancement often transforms concise inputs into substantially longer descriptions. To test whether output length alone yields better descriptive adequacy, we analyze H3-Context-IR separately on each task. Valid outputs are sorted by token length and divided into four equal-sized quartiles, from the shortest ( L ​ 1 L1 ) to the longest ( L ​ 4 L4 ).

paragraphs.en: The human study evaluates alignment at two levels: (i) the quality of enhanced prompts and (ii) the quality of downstream videos generated from those prompts. We recruit 60 experts and provide task-specific training before annotation. Each expert evaluates approximately 50 T2V-PE pairs, 20 I2V-PE pairs, and 10 R2V-PE pairs. The comparison pool contains 11 systems for T2V-PE, 4 for I2V-PE, and 3 for R2V-PE, including the original prompt as the no-enhancement baseline in every task.
paragraphs.zh: 这项人类研究从两个层面评估对齐效果：(i) 增强提示的质量，以及 (ii) 基于这些提示生成的下游视频的质量。 我们招募了 60 名专家，并在标注前为他们提供了任务特定的培训。 每位专家评估约 50 对 T2V-PE、20 对 I2V-PE 和 10 对 R2V-PE。 对比池包含 11 个用于 T2V-PE 的系统、4 个用于 I2V-PE 的系统以及 3 个用于 R2V-PE 的系统，其中原始提示在每个任务中均作为无增强基准。

paragraphs.en: For enhanced-prompt evaluation, annotators inspect the original instruction, target duration, reference assets when applicable, and an anonymized pair of enhanced prompts. Annotators make a separate choice for Semantic Fidelity, Internal Consistency, and Directorial Creation. For each dimension, they select the better candidate, both good, or both bad. For downstream-video evaluation, annotators inspect the source request and references together with an anonymized pair of generated videos and make the same dimension-specific judgment. Candidate identities are hidden, and the left and right positions are randomized independently for every comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 在增强提示评估中，标注员会检查原始指令、目标时长（如适用）、参考素材以及一对经过匿名处理的增强提示。 标注员需分别对语义保真度、内部一致性和导演性创作做出独立判断。 对于每个维度，他们需选择更优的候选项、两者皆好或两者皆差。 在下游视频评估中，标注员会结合源请求和参考素材，以及一对经过匿名处理的生成视频进行审查，并作出相同的维度特定判断。 候选项的身份会被隐藏，且每次比较中左右位置均独立随机化。

paragraphs.en: We aggregate the pairwise choices with a Bradley-Terry model to obtain a system ranking for each task, evaluation level, and dimension. paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Bradley-Terry 模型对成对选择进行汇总，从而为每个任务、评估级别和维度获得系统排名。 接着，我们计算这一由专家得出的排名与相应的自动维度得分之间的斯皮尔曼相关性。 所得系数报告于表 5 中。

paragraphs.en: PEBench prompts are generated from an expert-designed taxonomy and undergo manual verification. During curation, we remove personal information, identifiable private individuals, sensitive political content, and material that may raise privacy or cultural concerns. Reference assets originate from public benchmarks or model-assisted generation. We retain source and license metadata and release only assets permitted for redistribution, providing source identifiers for restricted material. Videos generated for downstream validation are used only for evaluation and are not included in the benchmark release. We release the verified prompts, legally shareable reference assets, and evaluation framework to support reproducible research.
paragraphs.zh: PEBench 提示词由专家设计的分类体系生成，并经过人工验证。 在整理过程中，我们会删除个人信息、可识别的私人个体信息、敏感的政治内容以及可能引发隐私或文化担忧的材料。 参考资产源自公开基准测试或由模型辅助生成。 我们会保留来源和许可元数据，仅发布允许重新分发的资产，并为受限材料提供来源标识。 为下游验证生成的视频仅用于评估，不包含在基准测试的发布版本中。 我们发布经过验证的提示词、可合法共享的参考资产以及评估框架，以支持可复现的研究。

paragraphs.en: One limitation is the scale of the benchmark. Although 1,100 expert-verified cases provide broad coverage across three PE settings, 35 task types, and diverse conditioning patterns, they cannot represent the full range of rapidly evolving video-generation requests. Future work will expand PEBench with additional domains, languages, reference configurations, and emerging control formats, enabling more comprehensive evaluation and supporting the development of increasingly general prompt enhancers.
paragraphs.zh: 一个局限性是基准测试的规模。 尽管 1,100 个经过专家验证的案例覆盖了三种 PE 设置、35 种任务类型和多样的条件模式，但它们无法代表快速演变的视频生成请求的全部范围。 未来的工作将通过增加更多领域、语言、参考配置和新出现的控制格式来扩展 PEBench，从而实现更全面的评价，并支持开发更具通用性的提示增强器。

paragraphs.en: A second limitation is the comparatively limited model coverage for I2V-PE and R2V-PE. Unlike T2V-PE, few existing methods support multimodal prompt enhancement, and only a small number of proprietary systems, such as H3-Context-IR, provide accessible PE interfaces. Consequently, our I2V-PE and R2V-PE evaluations include fewer baselines. We will continue updating PEBench as more multimodal PE methods become available, enabling broader comparisons across open and proprietary systems.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个局限性是 I2V-PE 和 R2V-PE 的模型覆盖范围相对有限。 与 T2V-PE 不同，现有的方法中很少有支持多模态提示增强的，而且只有少数专有系统（例如 H3-Context-IR）提供了可访问的 PE 接口。 因此，我们的 I2V-PE 和 R2V-PE 评估所包含的基线模型更少。 随着更多多模态 PE 方法的出现，我们将持续更新 PEBench，从而在开源和专有系统之间实现更广泛的比较。
